name: Testosterone enanthate
description: A long-chain ester of testosterone in oil, approved for testosterone replacement in males with hypogonadism, including a subcutaneous auto-injector presentation (Xyosted). A Schedule III controlled substance.

systems.note: Androgen replacement is the labelled indication.
Lean-mass accrual is an intended effect.
Prostatic growth and rising PSA are labelled.
Blood pressure rise carries a boxed warning on the Xyosted presentation.

monitors.why: Labelled monitoring parameter for replacement adequacy.
Documents suppression of the endogenous axis.
